generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The retry loop in `compareAndExchangeRegister` will result in an infinite loop if a `BaseServiceException` is thrown with a status code other than `PRECONDITION_FAILED` (412) or `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS` (429). In such cases, the exception is neither thrown nor returned, causing the `while(true)` loop to repeat indefinitely. A fallback `throw e;` or similar mechanism should be added for unhandled status codes.

review_comment: No, also I should document them 👍
Scratch that. I forgot repository metadata are not true settings.
If we're good with retrying the whole thing from the start in the event of a throttle, we could do this one level up (where it's async) so we don't have to sleep.
Sleeping seems ok here to me, if we're being throttled on a CAS then we probably shouldn't be freeing up the thread to do some other blob-store operation.
